info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Human Resource Management Employee Certification-v5-spec
info.description: The Employee Certification Management API facilitates the processing of employee certifications within the banking sector. This endpoint allows authorized personnel to submit and register new certifications for employees, ensuring compliance with industry regulations. Common users include HR professionals and compliance officers who need to maintain accurate and up-to-date certification records. Engaging with this API enhances operational efficiency and supports workforce development programs by streamlining certification management.

post.summary: Create a new employee certification record.
post.description: This endpoint allows the creation of a certification record for an employee within the human resource management system. This enables organizations to track employee qualifications and certifications effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit an employee certification in the Human Resource Management system. It requires specific fields to define the employee's certification details and ensure proper processing.

201.description: The employee certification has been successfully created.
